title.narrative: EU Regional Action for Roma Education: Increased Education Support and Opportunities for Roma Students in the Western Balkans and Turkey (RARE), phase II

description.narrative: This action will enable the second phase of the Regional Action for Roma Education & Employment in the Western Balkans and Turkey. The project will support Roma children and youth in accessing better quality and long-term education, reducing drop-outs and supporting gender equality. It will also contribute to increasing the potential and opportunities for employability of Roma youth, facilitating the transfer from education to employment.
